source.note: Generated from v1 by a script kept outside the repo; see README.md in this folder.

mappings: v1 parse result `{ ok: true, model }` -> `{ kind: "ok" }`; `{ ok: false, kind, message }` -> `{ kind, message }`.
Relationship field `identifying` -> `isIdentifying` (op args use the port names).
Op args are written in the port's signatures; the generator maps them to v1's positional arguments (addRel(m, from, to, extra), updateAttribute(m, entityName, index, patch), ...).
Ops returning `{ model, id }` are compared on the model; ops returning null (renameEntity on an invalid name) expect `null`.
Text is measured at 7px per character (v1's DOM-free fallback = approximateTextWidth in the port).
Layout positions are top-left corners rounded to 2 decimals. Place cases start from v1's dagre layout of the previous code (rounded), stored in `start`.
